goal: Implement mathematical squarified treemap layout engine with hierarchical grouping and aspect ratio minimization

function_signatures: export interface TreemapNode<T> { id: string; value: number; data: T; }
export interface TreemapRect<T> { id: string; x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number; data: T; }
export interface TreemapGroup<T> { id: string; label: string; nodes: TreemapNode<T>[]; totalValue: number; }
export interface TreemapGroupRect<T> { id: string; label: string; x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number; totalValue: number; items: TreemapRect<T>[]; }
export function computeSquarifiedTreemap<T>(nodes: TreemapNode<T>[], width: number, height: number): TreemapRect<T>[]
export function computeHierarchicalTreemap<T>(groups: TreemapGroup<T>[], width: number, height: number, groupHeaderHeight?: number): TreemapGroupRect<T>[]

execution_steps: Write unit test suite in frontend/src/__tests__/treemap_layout.test.js verifying area conservation, non-overlap, and positive coordinates
Implement computeSquarifiedTreemap and computeHierarchicalTreemap in frontend/src/lib/treemapLayout.ts
Verify with npx tsc --noEmit and oxlint
